tests.title: Checkout add-on offers refresh correctly after removing a cart item
tests.goal: After a cart item is removed, the promotion add-on section only offers products of promotions the cart still qualifies for, at their correct price.
preconditions: Logged-in member; active add-on promotions 650 (reach $100) and 620 (reach $1000, 水晶手串1 at $0)
data: Product C (HKD 600) and product test 2 (HKD 1,000), found at runtime

steps.text: Add C and product test 2 to the cart and open /checkout
Remove product test 2 with the row remove icon
Read the add-on section without reloading

expected.text: The "promotion" add-on lists its own Group B products (9吋公仔 A/B, 巨寶 A/B, Shoes C at HKD 100)
No product from a promotion the cart no longer qualifies for is offered

checks.label: The "promotion" add-on lists its own Group B products (9吋公仔 A/B, 巨寶 A/B, Shoes C at HKD 100)
No product from a promotion the cart no longer qualifies for is offered

notes: Stale 水晶手串1 HKD 0.00 shown under "promotion" after removing product test 2 (twice).
